requirements_for_evidence_promotion: Preserve source identity, version, license/access basis, original lineage and the exact supported claim.
Separate owner-described disproportionate impact from a source-verified population/period-specific disparity estimate.
Resolve aliases, topics and condition concepts before computing catalog union or overlap; do not announce153 unique conditions.
Trace original studies, methods, populations, denominators, instruments, availability time and uncertainty.
Count repeated original evidence once; platform agreement is not automatic independent corroboration.
Test condition-specific earliest signals, appropriate action, outcomes, competing explanations, equity and harms.
Return reviewed findings to supporting platforms through tested authorized interfaces; do not promote catalog content directly into clinical advice.
